questions.question: In which year did the Chandigarh city assume the unique distinction of being the capital city of both Punjab and Haryana while it itself was declared as a Union Territory?

options: Hunting of wild animals and gathering of wild plant foods
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Hunting of wild animals and gathering of wild plant foods) है।

options: Electro negativity of copper is the highest.
Electro positivity of copper is the highest.

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Copper is second only to silver in electrical conductance.) है।

questions.question: In May 2025, the central government notified 34 biostimulants to boost which of the following?
options: Promotion of organic farming without chemical inputs
Development of synthetic fertilisers for agriculture
Production of genetically modified seeds and crops
Manufacturing and application of plant growth-enhancing substances
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Manufacturing and application of plant growth-enhancing substances) है।
